dedupe_keys.name: follow etsap industrial energy demands industrial energy demand data set v2 1 0

description: The Follow ETSAP project releases a regionalised industrial-energy demand dataset for 2018. Zenodo archives version 2.1.0 under CC BY 4.0 and links a repository. The description names national production quantities for iron and steel, non-ferrous metals, minerals, pulp and paper, chemicals and petrochemicals, plus best-available-technology and theoretical-minimum energy intensities. It also provides TIAM region membership, electricity and fuel demand by branch and process route, inefficiency factors and validation calculations. These inputs can parameterise global industrial decarbonisation simulation pathways or energy-system models that distinguish feedstock from energy fuel. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. A limitation is that 2018 production and technology mixes are not present-day observations; the derived regional demands depend on sector mapping and efficiency assumptions. The Zenodo archive declares CC BY, while the linked repository metadata do not classify its licence, so rights should be checked for live-repository reuse. No ZIP was downloaded and no regional total was reproduced.
